instrument_cost.note: NMT `detail` stores per-callsite data in native memory, so it inflates non-heap. Reported so the figure can be stated net-of-instrument. Valid to compare across arms only when every arm ran the same NMT level.

attribution.note: Heap residency is measured, never derived by subtracting declared -Xmx from RSS: without AlwaysPreTouch, -Xms commits pages it never touches, so committed > resident. See triad report §5.
